The rule by which 25 (core) / 8 (flank) members drop out of S37-07 could not be identified: it is not truncation of the window at the chromosome ends (all 3,570 +/-1 kb windows fall inside the chromosome), and it is not merging of neighbouring TSSs (merging at 10 bp gives 3,547, at 25 bp 3,449).
